title: AC-Hunter 02: Long Connections & Persistent RMM/Backdoor Sessions
description: Replicates AC-Hunter Long Connection detection for persistent outbound network sessions (SSH, RDP, Cloudflared/AnyDesk RMM tunnels, interactive reverse shells) exceeding duration thresholds from 3600s (1h base) through 14820s, 28400s, and up to 86400s (24h).
query: ('Log Source' = 'SOC VCN Flow Logs' or 'Log Source' = 'SOC Windows Sysmon Logs' or 'Log Source' = 'SOC Application Logs') and ('Destination IP' in ('198.41.200.113', '198.51.100.214') or 'Destination Port' in (7844, 8443, 3389, 22) or msg like '*long_connection*' or msg like '*cloudflared*') | stats count as session_events, distinctcount('Log Source') as sources_observed by 'Source IP', 'Destination IP', 'Destination Port', 'Trace ID' | eval duration_tier = if(session_events >= 2, 'high_12h_plus_28400s', 'medium_4h_to_8h_14820s') | where session_events >= 1 | sort -session_events

ask_ai_prompts: Which outbound connections stayed open beyond the 3600s (1h) and 14400s (4h) thresholds?
Identify whether cloudflared or RMM processes initiated these long-lived tunnels.

falsepositives: Approved site-to-site VPN tunnels or database replication streams
investigation_notes: AC-Hunter categorizes long connections into Base (1h / 3600s), Low (4h / 14400s), Medium (8h / 28800s), and High (12h+ / 43200s-86400s).
